user.title: Add Camera Lux Sensor
user.description: Create a lux sensor from a camera entity or image URL. The defaults give good results out of the box: pick the Algorithm by camera type (see the documentation) and adjust Full-scale lux if readings run high or low. A camera in IR mode measures its own infrared illuminator, not ambient light — enable IR detection and choose what to do when an IR frame is detected: measure it with a chosen curve, report a fixed value, or go offline.

data.name: Name
data.full_scale_lux: Full-scale lux (calibration: raises or lowers all readings)
data.frozen_detection: Offline when the feed is frozen (double-pull byte check; keep off for infrequently updated image sources)
data.ir_chroma_threshold: IR chroma threshold (frames below this color level count as IR; per-camera)
data.ir_algorithm: IR algorithm — what to do when an IR frame is detected
data.ir_fixed_lux: IR fixed lux (used by Fixed brightness; default 0)

abort.already_configured: This Camera Lux sensor is already configured.
